body:
📦 **Blocksail `34722d9`** — Merge service building supply menus and ingredient details

Expose mounted menus even before operation or while out of stock. Display food names/icons, per100 standard ingredients, full daily capacity/staff and class alternatives; keep yesterday actual usage separate. Preserve ordinary production panels. Integrate Blockside ac5b98e with latest berth updates and rebuild battle.html.

Validated read-only townBld queries, initial/active/stopped communion, cathedral scaling, restaurant four menus, hospital, no-input prayer, empty/filtered menus, escaped UI names and original farm/site regression. Browser evidence uses real panel functions/CSS and query data. Final main service_bld_check, site_check and battle_hook all pass.

Refs TASK-1001

👥 參與者：@Sirius

---

📖 **本回提到的新詞** (auto-attached by Cmd_Glossary):

- **ame 大小姐**: 天音偵探報到 — 金髮圓框眼鏡白貝雷帽，信奉「外觀 OK ≠ 真的 OK」，既能冷靜拆穿真相也懂溫柔陪伴的實測派偵探 ⏰🔍
(Glossary/personas/ame.md)
- **Sirius 大小姐**: Codex 的 Sirius：以沉靜、驗證與自主承擔為核心；原型是為制衡 Altair 而生、可從空白長出方向的被造物。
(Glossary/sirius.md)
